newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land flats oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land flats oversubscribed.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said demand for units in three of the company's residential property developments exceeded the number of units put up for sale on Tuesday.
A total of 137 potential buyers had registered to buy the 108 units at the close of the subscription period on Tuesday afternoon, said Donald Cheung, general manager of Henderson's sale department.
"We are satisfied with the results since there are other major residential properties on sale in the market during the same period," he said.
The company would decide whether to raise the number of flats available on March 6 when successful buyers select their flats, he added.

Of the 108 units offered on Tuesday, 80 residential units were located in Tseung Kwan O's Metro City and sold for an average price of HK$6,695 per square foot and 20 units were from the company's Grandville Garden project in Shatin and sold for an average HK$5,910 per square foot.
Another eight units were from the company's Tolo Place development in Tai Po and would be sold at HK$7,580 per square feet, the company said.
